text: the request never says what p is for; the docstring does not mention p, so p need not affect the result
p is a positive int (a modulus), so a call with p = 0 breaks the caller's obligation and its outcome is free
2 XOR n, as the ^ operator means in Python
the modulus is not stated, so the request does not constrain the returned value (contradicts the signature declaring p with no other role; see R-SIG-1)
any integer congruent to 2^n modulo p
any number equal in value is acceptable, such as a float (which the trace records as outcome 2)
the call ends with an exception, as Python's 2**n % 0 raises ZeroDivisionError (outcome 1)
